scope: Native recorded 3D replay workflow acceptance; not physical accuracy, task success or live reaction timing
checks: Native visual groups and active collision proxies are separate; six joints and recorded-replay scope are visible
Joint and gripper readouts exactly follow the selected measured row
Keyboard orbit and camera presets alter the rendered 3D view
Playback, overlays and pause work; paused unchanged scenes stop requesting renders
Desktop, phone and landscape layouts have no horizontal overflow and preserve 44px controls
Missing motion/step combinations are withheld rather than causing a replay error
Malformed body layout and unavailable WebGL2 fail visibly without fabricated geometry
Browsers without DecompressionStream use exact uncompressed local binaries
